script: az rest --method GET --uri 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/directory/deletedItems/microsoft.graph.application?$select=id,appId,displayName,deletedDateTime' 2>&1 | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(a["deletedDateTime"], a["displayName"], a["appId"], "obj="+a["id"]) for a in sorted(d.get("value",[]), key=lambda x: x.get("deletedDateTime",""), reverse=True)[:15]]'
